description: This file defines the interface for Git stash management routines in the libgit2 library, including enums, function prototypes, and callback types for stash operations.

methods.name: git_stash_save
methods.description: Saves local modifications to a new stash, returning the object id of the stash commit.

methods.name: git_stash_apply_init_options
methods.description: Initializes stash apply options with default values.

methods.name: git_stash_apply
methods.description: Applies a stashed state from the stash list at a given index.

methods.name: git_stash_foreach
methods.description: Iterates over all stashed states, invoking a callback for each.

methods.name: git_stash_drop
methods.description: Removes a stashed state from the stash list at a specified index.

methods.name: git_stash_pop
methods.description: Applies a stashed state and removes it from the stash list if successful.
